title: Synthesis and characterization of a g-C3N4/UiO-66/Ag2CrO4 ternary nanocomposite for the photo-catalytic degradation of methyl orange under visible-light irradiation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,24704-24718
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06399J, Paper

Gudisa Hailu Chala, Habtamu Tegegne Metikie, Ephriem Tadesse Mengesha, Abi M Tadesse
In this study, novel g-C3N4/UiO-66/Ag2CrO4 ternary nanocomposites with different mass ratios of Ag2CrO4 were synthesized effectively via the precipitation method for the treatment of polluted water.
